basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Field Assistant Tech Support Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy of Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for 1 temporary Field Assistant - Tech Support post in the research project "An AI Enabled Platfrom for Diagnosis Prognosis and Health Management of Mining Electrical Systems: A Case Study on the Drag Line" (Project Code – R/AEH), sponsored by Central Mine Planning and Design Institute Limited (CMPDI). The consolidated compensation is up to ₹25,000 per month for 12 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. The essential qualification is a Bachelors degree

how_to_apply: The notice invites applications online for the assignment under project code R/AEH. The last date of application is 25 November 2026; the notice prints no time. It does not name the website or describe the form-filling steps.
Application fee: General / Male / OBC ₹0, Female ₹0, SC/ST ₹0.
The notice states that the application fee is to be deposited in the bank account below through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking etc.
The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

rows.details: An AI Enabled Platfrom for Diagnosis Prognosis and Health Management of Mining Electrical Systems: A Case Study on the Drag Line (Project Code – R/AEH)
Central Mine Planning and Design Institute Limited (CMPDI)
12 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation up to ₹25,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience
Frequent visits to various CMPDI coal mines

content_sections.heading: About the Institute and Project
content_sections.text: The notice says the project is undertaken in the Department of Mining Engineering of the institute, while its Dept./Centre/School entry reads Electrical Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Under "Desired Experience" the notice states what the selected candidates will be required to do: Undertake frequent visits to various CMPDI coal mines for on-site data collection, field measurements, equipment installation/inspection and technical support. Be willing to travel extensively and work in industrial and mining environments. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. The notice prints no desirable qualification and no NET or GATE requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelors degree in science / 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to 25000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The notice names no other allowance. The assignment is temporary and runs for 12 months or until the project is terminated, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Field Assistant - Tech Support
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications online for the assignment under project code R/AEH. The last date of application is 25 November 2026; the notice prints no time. It does not name the website or describe the form-filling steps. Application fee: General / Male / OBC ₹0, Female ₹0, SC/ST ₹0. The notice states that the application fee is to be deposited in the bank account below through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking etc. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview and says that mere possession of the minimum qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for it. It does not state the interview date, the mode or how candidates are chosen for it.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Field Assistant - Tech Support in the project with Project Code R/AEH.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 25 November 2026. The notice prints no closing time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Field Assistant - Tech Support post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelors degree in science / 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to 25000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice shows the fee as 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST. It still prints a State Bank of India account and asks that transaction details be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online, and the last date is 25 November 2026. The notice does not print the website address.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project, for 12 months or until the project is terminated, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will all applicants be called for the interview?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Will the selected candidate have to travel?
faq.answer: Yes. The selected candidates must make frequent visits to various CMPDI coal mines and be willing to travel extensively and work in industrial and mining environments.
